## Load packages and data
```{r}
# load tidyverse for data wrangling and ggplot2
library(tidyverse)
# read the covariate and gene expression data in its original state
covar <- read.csv("C:/Users/tanne/OneDrive/GradSchool/Foundations of Data Science/Project/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
expr <- read.csv("C:/Users/tanne/OneDrive/GradSchool/Foundations of Data Science/Project/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
# read the probe-to-gene-name linker file
genes <- read.csv("C:/Users/tanne/OneDrive/GradSchool/Foundations of Data Science/Project/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")
```

## Inspect Covariance data
```{r}
# show variable names, types, and first values in the covariate file
str(covar)
# show summary statistics to spot missing codes or odd values
summary(covar)
```

## Inspect gene expression data
```{r}
# number of rows (probes) and columns (samples)
dim(expr)
# first 5 column names to see how samples are labeled
names(expr)[1:5]
```

## Inspect gene name linker file
```{r}
# structure of the probe-to-gene linker file
str(genes)
```

### Clean covariance data
```{r}
# remove the label/text before each value in columns 3-10
covar[3:10] <- lapply(covar[3:10], function(x) sub(".*: ", "", x))

# convert the continuous covariates from text to numbers
covar$mat_age_yrs <- as.numeric(covar$mat_age_yrs)
covar$delivery_gestAge_wks <- as.numeric(covar$delivery_gestAge_wks)
covar$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks <- as.numeric(covar$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks)
covar$mat_BMI <- as.numeric(covar$mat_BMI)
covar$mat_vitD <- as.numeric(covar$mat_vitD)

# convert the categorical covariates to factors with readable labels
covar$preg_preeclampsia <- factor(covar$preg_preeclampsia, levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia"))
covar$mat_asthma <- factor(covar$mat_asthma, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Healthy", "Asthma"))
covar$batch_Microarray <- factor(covar$batch_Microarray)

# confirm after cleaning
summary(covar)
```

### Verify sample matching
```{r}
# check that expression sample columns have  matching geoID in the covariate data
all(names(expr)[-1] %in% covar$geoID)

# check that covariate geoIDs have matching expression column
all(covar$geoID %in% names(expr)[-1])

# check how many expression probes appear in the linker file
sum(expr$X %in% genes$PROBEID)

# check whether any probe IDs are repeated in the linker file
sum(duplicated(genes$PROBEID))
```


## Merge names with expression data and create analysis dataset
```{r}
# attach gene names to the expression data by matching probe IDs
expr_named <- merge(genes, expr, by.x = "PROBEID", by.y = "X")

# check that many rows remain and for duplicate gene names
nrow(expr_named)
sum(duplicated(expr_named$GENE))

# seshape to long format: one row per gene per sample
expr_long <- pivot_longer(expr_named, cols = -c(PROBEID, GENE), names_to = "geoID", values_to = "expression")

# join covariates onto each sample by geoID
dat <- left_join(expr_long, covar, by = "geoID")

# confirm size (78,500 rows)
dim(dat)
```

## Define categorical variables and find candidate genes
```{r}
# create vitamin D status, standard deficiency cutoff of 20 ng/mL
dat$vitD_status <- factor(ifelse(dat$mat_vitD < 20, "Deficient", "Sufficient"), levels = c("Sufficient", "Deficient"))

# create obesity status,standard BMI cutoff of 30 kg/m2
dat$obese <- factor(ifelse(dat$mat_BMI >= 30, "Obese", "Not obese"), levels = c("Not obese", "Obese"))

# check which known preeclampsia-related genes are on 500-probe array
intersect(c("FLT1", "ENG", "LEP", "PGF", "VEGFA", "PAPPA2", "INHBA", "HTRA1"), expr_named$GENE)
```

## Rank genes by pre-eclampsia difference
```{r}
# for each gene, compare mean expression between preeclampsia and normal pregnancies
gene_rank <- dat %>%
  group_by(GENE) %>%
  summarise(mean_diff = mean(expression[preg_preeclampsia == "Preeclampsia"]) - mean(expression[preg_preeclampsia == "Normal"]),
            p_value = t.test(expression ~ preg_preeclampsia)$p.value) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# show 10 genes with strongest difference
head(gene_rank, 10)

# show the range of expression values across genes and samples
summary(dat$expression)
```

## Gene of interest
```{r}
# keep only rows for chosen gene
gene_dat <- filter(dat, GENE == "RUNDC3A")
# confirm one row per sample
nrow(gene_dat)

# plot the distribution of RUNDC3A expression across all samples
p1 <- ggplot(gene_dat, aes(x = expression)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "RUNDC3A Expression (log2)", y = "Number of Samples",
       title = "Distribution of RUNDC3A Expression") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p1
```

## BMI vs Gene Expression
```{r}
# Plot RUNDC3A expression against maternal BMI with a fitted regression line
p2 <- ggplot(gene_dat, aes(x = mat_BMI, y = expression)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Maternal BMI (kg/m²)", y = "RUNDC3A Expression (log2)",
       title = "RUNDC3A Expression by Maternal BMI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p2
```

## Preeclampsia and Vit D status
```{r}
# plot RUNDC3A expression by preeclampsia status, split by vitamin D status
p3 <- ggplot(gene_dat, aes(x = preg_preeclampsia, y = expression, fill = vitD_status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sufficient" = "#E69F00", "Deficient" = "#56B4E9")) +
  labs(x = "Pregnancy Outcome", y = "RUNDC3A Expression (log2)",
       fill = "Vitamin D Status", title = "RUNDC3A Expression by Preeclampsia and Vitamin D Status") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p3
```

## Save figures 
```{r}

ggsave("fig1_histogram.png", p1, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("fig2_scatter.png", p2, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("fig3_boxplot.png", p3, width = 7, height = 5)
```
